facts.fact: Xinhua reports President Museveni launched on 4 December 2024 the fifth phase of the National Data Transmission Backbone Infrastructure (NBI), which is to extend internet access to remote regions.
facts.system: National Data Transmission Backbone Infrastructure Phase V

systems.system: National Data Transmission Backbone Infrastructure Phase V

UGA.note: Phases 1-4 figures are not stated as rural sites.

facts.fact: Xinhua reports the first four NBI phases have covered nearly 50 percent of Uganda, laying 4,172 km of fibre across 63 districts.
Xinhua reports President Museveni launched construction of NBI phase five on 4 December 2024, financed by China EXIM and implemented by Huawei.

UGA.note: Backbone built by Huawei; no government-run system stated.
